Section 3.2: conditional joint law Sec
nodes.statement:
Let~$(\lambda_1,\ldots, \lambda_K,\lambda_{K+1})$ be the first knots of the LARS and let~$(\,\widehat \imath_1,\ldots, \widehat \imath_K)$ be the first variables entering along the~LARS path.
If~$(\,\widehat \imath_1,\ldots, \widehat \imath_K)$ satisfies~(2.10), then, conditional on the selection event~$\{\,\widehat \imath_1,\ldots, \widehat \imath_K,\lambda_{K+1}\}$, the vector~$(\lambda_{1},\ldots,\lambda_K)$ obeys a law with the following density~(w.r.t. Lebesgue measure) 
\[
{\mathrm Q}^{-1}_{(\,\widehat \imath_1,\ldots,\widehat \imath_K,\lambda_{K+1})}
\,
\Big(
\prod_{k=1}^K \varphi_{m_k,v_k^2}(\ell_k)
\Big)
\,
\mathds{1}_{\{\ell_1\geq \ell_{2}\geq\cdots\geq\ell_{K}\geq\lambda_{K+1}\}}\text{ at point }(\ell_1, \ell_{2},\ldots,\ell_{K}),
\]
where~${\mathrm Q}_{(\,\widehat \imath_1,\ldots,\widehat \imath_K,\lambda_{K+1})}$ is a normalizing constant,~$\varphi_{m_k,v_k^2}$ is the standard Gaussian density with mean~$m_k$ and variance~$v_k^2:=\sigma^2\rho_k^2$, are explicitly given by~(3.12) and~(3.13).

nodes.name: Section 3.5: power/Type II error Sec
nodes.statement:
Assume that the design~$X$ is orthogonal, namely~$X^\top X=\mathrm{Id}_{p}$.
Let~$a_0$ be an integer such that~$0\leq a_0\leq K-1$.
If~$\widehat m$ is chosen according to a procedure satisfying~{(2.17)}, then under the null hypothesis
\[
\mathds H_0\,:\ \text{`}X\beta^0\in H_{a_0}\,\text{'},
\] 
and conditional on the selection event~$\big\{\widehat m=a_0\big\}$, it follows that the test~$\mathcal{S}_{a_0,a_0+1,K+1}$ is uniformly more powerful than any of the tests~$ \mathcal{S}_{a,b,c}$ for~$a_0\leq a <b<c \leq K+1$.

nodes.name: Section 3.3: GSt FN testing Sec
nodes.statement:
Let~$a, b,$ and $c$ be such that~$0\leq a<b<c\leq K+1$.
Let~$(\lambda_1,\ldots, \lambda_K,\lambda_{K+1})$ be the first knots and let~$(\,\widehat \imath_1,\ldots, \widehat \imath_K)$ be the first variables entering along the~LARS path.
If~$(\,\widehat \imath_1,\ldots, \widehat \imath_K)$ satisfies~(2.10) and~$\widehat m$ is chosen according to a procedure satisfying~{(2.17)}, then under the null hypothesis
\[
\mathds H_0\,:\ \text{‘‘}X\beta^0\in H_{a}\,\text{''},
\] 
and conditional on the selection event~$\big\{\,\widehat m\leq a\big\}$, it follows that
\begin{equation}

\widehat\alpha_{abc}=\widehat\alpha_{abc}(\lambda_a,\lambda_b,\lambda_c, \widehat \imath_{1}, \ldots,\widehat \imath_{c-1}):=1-\frac{\mathds{F}_{abc}(\lambda_b)}{\mathds{F}_{abc}(\lambda_a)}\sim\mathcal{U}(0,1),
\end{equation}
namely, it is uniformly distributed over~$(0,1)$.

nodes.name: Section 3.4: GtSt FN testing Sec
nodes.statement:
Let~$a, b,$ and $c$ be such that~$0\leq a<b<c\leq K+1$.
Let~$(\lambda_1,\ldots, \lambda_{K+1})$ be the first knots and let~$(\,\widehat \imath_1,\ldots, \widehat \imath_K)$ be the first variables entering along the~LARS path.
If~$(\,\widehat \imath_1,\ldots, \widehat \imath_K)$ satisfies~(2.10) and~$\widehat m$ is chosen according to a procedure satisfying~{(2.17)} then under the null hypothesis
\[
\mathds H_0\,:\ \text{`}X\beta^0\in H_{a}\,\text{'},
\] 
and conditional on the selection event~$\big\{\widehat m \leq a\big\}$, it follows that
\[
 \widehat  \beta_{abc}= \widehat  \beta_{abc}( {\Lambda_a},{ \Lambda_b},{ \Lambda_c}, \widehat \imath_1, \ldots, \widehat \imath_{K}):= 1 - 
  \frac{\widetilde{\mathds{F}}_{abc}(\Lambda_b)}
 {\widetilde{\mathds{F}}_{abc}(\Lambda_a)}\sim \mathcal{U}(0,1),
\]
where $\Lambda_k:=\lambda_k/\widehat\sigma$.

nodes.name: Section 3.6: FDR control Sec
nodes.statement:
Assume that the design is orthogonal, i.e.~$X^\top X=\mathrm{Id}_p$, and let~$K\in[p]$.
Let~$(\overline \imath_1,\ldots, \overline \imath_K)$ be the first variables entering along the~LARS path.
Consider the~$p$-values given by~(3.29) and the set~$\widehat R$ given by~(3.30).
Then
\[
\mathds E\big[\mathrm{FDP}|\overline\imath_1=i_1,\ldots,\overline\imath_K=i_K\big]\leq\alpha,
\]
and so~$\mathrm{FDR}$ is bounded above by~$\alpha$.
